auditRule: URL count is not evidence-lineage count. Reproductions/copies of one primary work remain one primary lineage; multiple pages from one institution remain one institutional lineage unless they bind materially independent records. Deep Anchor acceptance requires contemporaneous material where reasonably accessible plus an independent retrospective/quantitative lineage and explicit rival/failure evidence.

anchors.primaryEvidence: surviving Watt condenser/workshop material and early full-size Boulton & Watt engine evidence catalogued by Science Museum
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: Newcomen/water-power alternatives plus Roebuck financing failure
anchors.boundary: The batch does not yet include a separately digitized 1769 patent specification; the Science Museum curator history binds the patent and surviving material. Add a primary patent scan only if later theory coding turns on exact claim language.

anchors.primaryEvidence: surviving c.1775 Arkwright production water frame; Jenny/Mule evidence is partly reconstructed museum material
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: jenny versus water-frame versus mule capabilities and initially low-productivity mechanized plants
anchors.boundary: Hargreaves and Crompton entries use later replicas rather than surviving original machines. No causal claim may depend on replica provenance alone.

anchors.primaryEvidence: surviving Wilkinson boring hardware, Maudslay original lathe and Portsmouth machinery
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: Smeaton prior boring geometry and slow diffusion of Portsmouth integrated production
anchors.boundary: Later coding must separate precision-machine principles that diffused from the Portsmouth production-system configuration that remained locally exceptional.

anchors.primaryEvidence: two digital custodial copies of Lavoisier's 1789 Traité; these count as one primary-work lineage, not two independent experiments
independentLineages: peer-reviewed Studies in History and Philosophy of Science
anchors.t2OrEquivalent: Ursula Klein's peer-reviewed counter-reading of the Chemical Revolution
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: phlogiston continuity and Lavoisier's retained caloric/older categories
anchors.boundary: The word 'revolution' is not pre-accepted as a causal fact; independent historiography explicitly disputes how discontinuous Lavoisier's ontology/method really was.

anchors.primaryEvidence: Royal Society 20 March 1800 Volta manuscript plus Smithsonian copy of the published 1800 paper
independentLineages: peer-reviewed Journal of the History of the Neurosciences
anchors.t2OrEquivalent: peer-reviewed historical reconstruction of the Galvani–Volta controversy
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: Galvani/Volta competing causal interpretations plus Davy's failed aqueous-electrolysis route
anchors.boundary: Later scientific knowledge shows both initial positions captured real effects. The audit therefore rejects a simple 'Volta right/Galvani wrong' source summary.

anchors.primaryEvidence: 1799 platinum metre/kilogram archival artifacts documented by NIST; no separate scanned 1799 decree/commission dossier is yet in the batch
independentLineages: peer-reviewed Académie des sciences/Comptes Rendus history
anchors.t2OrEquivalent: two independent modern histories of metrology/metric origins
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: customary measurement persistence and later replacement of artifact-based definitions
anchors.boundary: For claims about political debate, geodetic procedure or early enforcement, obtain French primary commission/legal records before coding. Current bundle is sufficient for definition→artifact→metrology-institution trajectory only.

anchors.primaryEvidence: Jenner 1798 Inquiry, Pearson 1798 inquiry and 1800 Jenner/Woodville comparative statement
anchors.t2OrEquivalent: peer-reviewed histories of Jenner and smallpox vaccination
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: variolation, Jesty precursor, independent physician scrutiny and later uncertainty over propagated vaccine material
anchors.boundary: Eighteenth-century challenge evidence must be described historically, not upgraded to modern controlled-trial quality; biological identity of early vaccine material is itself historically uncertain.

anchors.primaryEvidence: surviving H4 plus 1765 Board of Longitude payment/reproduction proposal
independentLineages: independent historical synthesis of lunar-distance navigation
anchors.t2OrEquivalent: historical reconstruction of lunar-distance practice and chronometer displacement
anchors.rivalFailureEvidence: H2/H3 difficulties, Board rejection of one-voyage sufficiency, later H4 Observatory underperformance and surviving lunar-distance route
anchors.boundary: Much primary/trial material is within one Board/Royal Observatory archival family. Later claims about fairness of the Board–Harrison dispute require broader correspondence/secondary historiography; current bundle establishes the replication criterion itself, not who was normatively right.

schemaAudit.finding: The existing trajectory fields captured the eight source-native reconstructions without forcing LW0 theory labels. The main weakness was evidence-lineage identity, which is better represented by this separate audit than by adding a new historical ontology midstream.
retainedFriction: sourceBundle entries do not individually store accessedDate; batch-level accessedDate is used for this first physical dogfood
T0_material_via_T1_catalog must not be mistaken for an unmediated textual primary source
institutional pages can contain both primary-object metadata and retrospective interpretation
historical evidence quality is heterogeneous and must remain explicit rather than collapsed into one confidence score
schemaAudit.decision: Keep HD0 trajectory schema unchanged for the remainder of HD1 unless a later case becomes unrepresentable; do not churn the schema merely to normalize metadata that can live in source/audit manifests.
